# stocked — central agent knowledge

Read `~/Documents/ProjectKnowledge/README.md`, then `shared/AGENTS.md`, then
`projects/stocked/documents/README_FIRST.md`. All project facts, instructions and updates are maintained there.

Run `~/Documents/ProjectKnowledge/bin/project-knowledge read stocked`
at task start for current authoritative context. On Jarvis, this is the primary; on M1,
reads contact Jarvis and fall back to a clearly marked local cache if unavailable.
Use `project-knowledge record` for every completed task and `put` for changed facts/rules.
Never replace this entry point with a second copy of instructions. If the hub is missing,
stop work requiring its rules and ask for the knowledge checkout; do not invent them.
Historical reports describe past observations, not current state or permission.
